latest.headline: GTI_1990 Breaks Through with Maiden Season 5 Victory in Estonia
latest.paragraph: The WRC2 landscape shifted in Estonia as GTI_1990 finally captured his first victory of Season 5, ending the lengthy winning streak of his rival. Despite StoryVS_TTV setting the pace with five stage wins, a costly time penalty on stage five dropped him to eighth in the final standings. GTI_1990 capitalized on this consistency, completing the rally in 34 minutes 50.93 seconds to lead Janeman13 and speeedhunterr onto the podium. While StoryVS_TTV salvaged five points from the Power Stage, GTI_1990 remains the primary challenger as the championship battle intensifies.
